title: EC2 Direct Adapter
description:
Epic for all plan 19 (EC2 Direct Adapter) implementation work.

Plan document: docs/plans/19-ec2-direct-adapter.md
Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md

Implements DirectSandboxControl which manages one EC2 instance per sandbox, using SSM for process management. Provides CreateSandbox, DestroySandbox, LaunchProcess, KillProcess, GetProcessStatus, PauseSandbox, ResumeSandbox, crash recovery, and Close.

Includes the shared instance/ package (InstanceProvisioner interface + types) used by both plan 19 and plan 20.
